description: Regulatory Change Brief (Federal Register, EDGAR, Dockets) — Given an industry or topic and optional agencies, CFR parts, terms and companies, pulls recent US regulatory changes from official free sources: Federal Register final and proposed rules (with effective dates, comment deadlines and official URLs), SEC EDGAR 8-K items and other filings for named companies, and CourtListener dockets and opinions when the operator has a token. Days remaining are comp

agencies.description: Agency names, acronyms or Federal Register slugs, e.g. "SEC", "Environmental Protection Agency".

cfr_parts.description: CFR parts, e.g. "17 CFR 240" or "40 CFR 60".

companies.description: Company names, tickers or CIKs whose recent SEC filings (8-K items, 10-K/Q) to list.

focus.description: Weights ranking and the impact assessment toward operations, reporting or enforcement.

industry.description: Industry or topic, e.g. "community banks offering consumer credit". Used to plan searches and to judge impact.

sic_codes.description: SIC codes; industry context only, registrants are not enumerated by SIC.

terms.description: Federal Register search phrases, e.g. "data breach notification".

window_days.description: Publication window ending today, 1 to 180 days (default 30). Proposed rules published earlier whose comment period is still open are also included.

name: regulatory-change-brief
